mac.scope: Node-5 MAC scheduling conditional on native queue, receiver-state and random-draw inputs; startup [0,330) s with target [300,330) s.

hop_capacity.scope: Production HOP under native-timed first-16 local offers, actual TX notifications and ACK completion inputs; a test-owned FIFO represents the NWK boundary.

native_gate_context.interpretation: These are repeated gate evaluations, not unique applications. All denials in the observed capture are due to the per-neighbor capacity condition while global capacity is available.

limitations: MAC receives recorded receiver-state and queue inputs; it does not independently generate or validate reception outcomes.
HOP receives actual-transmission and ACK times; matching downstream admission does not establish parity of the upstream process producing those times.
First-16 capacity replay uses a test-owned FIFO, excludes the complete mixed local/relay workload and does not reconstruct production NWK state.
